heading: Assessable penalties with respect to liability for tax under chapter 42
lead: If any person becomes liable for tax under any section of chapter 42 (relating to private foundations and certain other tax-exempt organizations) by reason of any act or failure to act which is not due to reasonable cause and either— then such person shall be liable for a penalty equal to the amount of such tax.

tree.text: such person has theretofore been liable for tax under such chapter, or
such act or failure to act is both willful and flagrant,

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1987—Pub. L. 100–203 inserted “and certain other tax-exempt organizations” after “private foundations” in parenthetical.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1987 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 100–203 applicable to taxable years beginning after Dec. 22, 1987, see section 10712(d) of Pub. L. 100–203, set out as an Effective Date note under section 4955 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Jan. 1, 1970, see section 101(k)(1) of Pub. L. 91–172, set out as a note under section 4940 of this title.
